idConvention.summary: Per 100-block in the M.E.S.S. AprilTag language (tag36h11), the hundreds digit selects the size class and tag edge length. IDs x00-x49 are generic (no assigned role; the user may use them freely). IDs x50-x99 are dedicated (fixed purpose with a known local geometry profile). Dedicated IDs without a profile are unassigned.
